risks.risk: Capacity is not shown; a smaller drum than expected is worth less.

risks.proof: Photo looking inside the open drum in daylight, plus a photo of any moulded label or food grade mark on the base or side.
risks.if_unproven: as a used non-food-grade drum for general storage

risks.risk: Hairline cracks or a leaking base or lid seal.

risks.risk: Quantity on offer is unclear; the yard photo may be stock, not the drums sold.

proof_requests: Photo of the capacity marking on the drum or a tape measure showing height and width.
Photo looking inside an opened drum and of the base markings.

response.reason: These are ordinary blue plastic open-top water drums with lids, identified by type, so they can be priced per drum at the worst case: smaller common size, not food grade, possible leak. Capacity and inside photos would raise it.
